name: logs
title: Extension logs
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Read extension logs inside vqro, following new lines.
description: Shows the end of an extension's log file from the core host (including its rotated part), follows new lines while you stay at the end, and filters with /. Settings offers it as View log. Turn it off to lose the viewer; the core keeps writing the logs.

works_with.without: Open in a tab does nothing
Every client shows the log as a panel (no native tail renderer exists yet)
